verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Make runs distinct regional production zones (eu1, eu2, us1, us2), and API URLs are scoped per zone. This implies data is hosted in specific EU or US regions, but nothing documents that a user can choose a zone or that data stays within it. missing for 10: documentation that users can select a region or zone at signup or per organization, an explicit data-residency guarantee or policy, details on migrating between regions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: whitelisted for Make's production zones eu1/eu2/us1/us2.make.com/api/v2
